Specific counterexamples include source16M.HLQ24 mass4M/length0.25l versus the mini-test mass2M/length2l; source20N.HLQ27 compares mass changes in pendulum and spring systems, whereas the mini-test changes gravity for one mass-spring system. reviewed_nonmatches.test_item: Authored Q1, Q18 and Q19 against fixed197 A1 candidates
reviewed_nonmatches.finding: All candidate identities and native question/stem/parent-context fields were checked, with targeted rereading of short recall and projectile/drag/skydiver tasks. Added exact source-ID reservations for acceleration-component and post-parachute vector recall. Other surviving tasks require different numerical data, diagram transformations, initial conditions, motion stages or operations. Existing weak/candidate reservations remain fully additive; absence of automated text hits alone was not used as clearance.

limitations: Review completion is scoped to A1/C1 and does not certify every assessment item across all IB topics.
